newsitem.title: UK: Business Post sets special dividend.
newsitem.headline: Business Post sets special dividend.

text.p: Express mail service firm Business Post Group Plc said on Tuesday it declared a special dividend of 9.1p per share following a 24 percent rise in pretax profits to 16.1 million stg last year.
Business Post also said it would pay a second interim dividend of 6.9p per share, making a total of 10.5p for the year, a rise of 21 percent.
Turnover grew 23 percent to 80.6 million stg.
The company's shares slipped 3.0p to 480 by 0810 GMT. --London Newsroom +44 171 542 7717
